title: jobsctl shared definitions
description: Definitions referenced by every other jobsctl schema (config.json embeds copies).

job_id.description: Job id: jb- and 8 characters of a-z2-7; random, never reused. Output always uses the full id.

labels.description: The job's label pairs, sorted and unique; at most 32.

unique_key.description: A unique key: unique across all queues among non-terminal jobs.

job_env_name.description: A name given with --env or --pass-env; must not start with JOBSCTL_.

duration.description: DURATION: a positive integer and a unit (s, m, h, d).

seconds.description: A duration in JSON output: integer seconds.

actor.description: human:<user> or auto:<policy>; auto:jobsctl is reserved for jobsctl's own transitions and retention prunes.

hook_id.description: A hook's identity: its name if set, else its cmd.

ts.description: RFC 3339 timestamp in UTC with Z and millisecond precision.

config_path.description: Absolute path, or a path starting with ~/ (expanded to the user's home).

status.description: Non-terminal: queued, starting, running, held. Terminal: done, failed, canceled.

reason.description: End reason (interface: End reasons); only terminal jobs and attempts have one.

hold_reason.description: manual: hold of a queued job; escalated: a pre-start hook exited 13; exit_13: the job's own command exited 13.

untrusted_note.description: Untrusted: the resolve --note-file contents (at most 4096 bytes; maxLength counts characters and only approximates the byte limit); null if none.

argv.description: The job's argv (never a shell string); at most 4096 arguments and 1 MiB in total, no NUL byte. argv[0] is resolved at start.

env_map.description: The job's --env VAR=value entries (stored; non-secret by contract); at most 256 entries, each value at most 128 KiB (maxLength approximates the byte limit).

kind.description: exited: normal exit; signaled: died of a signal; spawn_failed: argv[0] could not be executed; unknown: no exit status was observed (lost from running, or forced after a shim loss).

code.description: Exit status for exited, else null.

signal.description: Signal number for signaled, else null.

core.description: true if a core dump was reported.

exit.description: The exit record of an attempt (interface: Exit record).

variable.description: pass_env_undefined: the variable; path_entry_dropped from cron install: the XDG_* variable left out (path is then omitted).

path.description: path_entry_dropped: the dropped PATH entry (omitted when variable names a dropped XDG_* variable).

warning.description: A non-fatal warning in command output.

status_rules.description: Consistency rules between status, reason, hold_reason, the exit record and the attempt fields (interface: End reasons, Exit record, Status transitions); used by job, hook_job, job_detail and attempt.

timeout.description: Resolved timeout in seconds; null: none.

effective.description: The resolved timeout, max_retries and kill_grace.

reason.description: End reason (interface: End reasons); null unless terminal.

hold_reason.description: Only for held jobs (interface: Hold reasons); else null.

cwd.description: The job's working directory (absolute, normalized lexically; symlinks kept).

pass_env.description: --pass-env names; their values come from env_file at start and are never stored.

rank.description: 1-based place among the queued jobs of its queue (pinned group first); null unless queued.

attempt.description: The number of the job's last attempt (0 if none; a requeue that deletes an attempt decrements it); the next claim uses attempt + 1.

retried_from_attempt.description: The job's attempt when retry last requeued it (retry --attempt N); never above attempt; null if never retried.

timeout.description: --timeout (add or retry) in seconds, or none (no timeout, overriding the queue's).

overrides.description: The job's own settings from add or retry; an absent key means the queue's setting applies.

effective.description: For starting and running jobs, the snapshot the shim recorded at start (once recorded); otherwise computed from the current config.

not_before.description: A pending automatic retry starts no earlier; null unless queued or held.

blocked_by.description: Queued jobs only: why the job cannot start now (the first that applies: not_before, env_file_unavailable, queue_paused for a queue cap of 0, global_paused for a global_cap of 0); null otherwise.

force_requested_by.description: Current attempt: set from a committed cancel --force request; on a terminal job exactly when the reason is forced.

override_hooks.description: Hook identities whose exit 13 counts as allow on the next start that runs hooks (release --override-escalation); empty otherwise.

shim_lost.description: true: the shim died while the job process lives; the job stays running and keeps its slot.

enqueued_at.description: Set at add; reset whenever the job returns to queued.

status_changed_at.description: The job's last status change (e.g. held since, running since); created_at until the first.

claimed_at.description: Current attempt: when it was claimed; null without a current attempt.

ended_at.description: When the job became terminal; null otherwise.

actor.description: The actor that added the job.

exit.description: Current attempt: the exit record; null when no job process was attempted, or it has not ended.

leftovers.description: Current attempt: processes left in the job's process group (interface: Leftovers); null when no probe was made.

resolved_path.description: Current attempt: absolute path argv[0] resolved to.

resolved_by.description: The actor of resolve; set exactly when reason is resolved.

job_base.description: The job fields shared by job, job_detail and hook_job (not closed: each of those adds its own fields and closes with unevaluatedProperties).

job.description: A job as printed by list, change, cancel and add (interface: Job object); show adds attempts and output.

status.description: Follows the job until the attempt ends; held for an escalation or exit 13.

reason.description: End reason (interface: End reasons); null unless terminal.

hold_reason.description: escalated or exit_13 while the attempt is held; else null.

claimed_at.description: When a pass claimed the job and created the attempt.

running_at.description: When the job process started (entered running).

ended_at.description: When the attempt ended (including a hold).

exit.description: The exit record; null when no job process was attempted, or it has not ended.

leftovers.description: Current attempt: processes left in the job's process group (interface: Leftovers); null when no probe was made.

resolved_path.description: Set whenever argv[0] was resolved (also for spawn_failed when exec failed); null for vetoed, cwd_missing, missing_env and when resolution failed or was not reached.

effective.description: The effective settings the shim recorded at start; null until recorded.

escalated_hooks.description: Identities of the pre-start hooks that escalated this attempt.

vetoed_by.description: Identity of the vetoing hook; set exactly when the reason is vetoed.

message.description: Untrusted: the hook's stderr, masked and sanitized, at most 4096 bytes (maxLength approximates the byte limit).

hook_messages.description: One entry per pre-start hook that vetoed or escalated this attempt.

decision_ids.description: Decision ids printed by this attempt's hooks.

force_requested_by.description: The actor of a committed cancel --force; on a terminal attempt exactly when the reason is forced.

resolved_by.description: The actor of resolve; null unless resolved.

jobsctl_version.description: Version of the jobsctl that claimed the attempt.

attempt.description: One attempt of a job (interface: Attempt object); created when a pass claims the job.

tail.description: Untrusted: the job's combined stdout/stderr tail, masked (mask_env, --pass-env and env_file values) and sanitized (interface: Masking and sanitizing); masking is best-effort and does not catch encoded or partial secrets.

bytes_seen.description: Every byte read from the job's output.

truncated.description: true when earlier output was dropped.

updated_at.description: When the tail was last flushed.

output.description: The output tail of one attempt (interface: Output capture).

attempts.description: Every attempt, oldest first; empty before the first claim.

output.description: The tail of the current attempt (or of --attempt N); null with --no-output or when the attempt has no tail.

job_detail.description: A job as printed by show, wait and add --wait: the job object plus attempts and output.

action.description: What was done (or, with --dry-run, would be done).

env_names.description: The names of the job's --env entries; values are never in a payload.

hook_job.description: The job object as in list, with env reduced to its variable names (env_names).

name.description: Optional; the hook's identity is name if set, else cmd.

cmd.description: Runs via /bin/sh -c in its own process group.

timeout.description: DURATION: a positive integer and a unit (s, m, h, d).

queues.description: Only jobs in these queues fire the hook; null: every queue.

exclude_queues.description: Jobs in these queues do not fire the hook.

labels.description: Only jobs with every one of these pairs fire the hook (AND).

name.description: Optional; the hook's identity is name if set, else cmd.

cmd.description: Runs via /bin/sh -c in its own process group.

timeout.description: DURATION: a positive integer and a unit (s, m, h, d).

queues.description: Only jobs in these queues fire the hook; null: every queue.

exclude_queues.description: Jobs in these queues do not fire the hook.

labels.description: Only jobs with every one of these pairs fire the hook (AND).

async.description: true runs the hook asynchronously, without blocking delivery of the job's other events; at most 8 async hooks run at once, one per job (post hooks only).

include_output.description: true puts the output tail into the payload (post hooks only).

cap.description: Absent: default_cap. null: unbounded. 0 holds the queue (nothing starts).

retry_delay.description: DURATION: a positive integer and a unit (s, m, h, d).

queue_config.description: Settings of one queue (interface: Config); per-queue settings take precedence over global config.
